_comment: Dasa year definitions (YearDefinition / YearLength, 75 slots: 0..24 nakshatra dasas, 25..59 rasi, 60..74 other; see src/core/dasas/yearDefinition.ts). capture.py --ini Key=Value replaces EVERY line of an array key, so one run sets one slot: --ini "YearDefinition=<slot> <def>" --ini "YearLength=<slot> <days>". Vimsottari is slot 0, Narayana 25, Karaka 73; the test (tests/dasaYears.test.ts) reads ini_overrides and checks the dasa of that slot. Restore the copy's jhcore/jhora.ini afterwards (golden/jhora-defaults.ini). Output: golden/jhora-dasa-years/<variant>/.
